integrity: Finite rational checks are supporting calculations, not a proof of limiting distributions. No claim of independent mathematical verification or certification.
scientific_limitations: Independent hyperedge indicators, rank-wise exchangeability, finite limiting vertex degree and maximal individual edge probability tending to zero. Full countable empirical-spectrum weak convergence is shown, not a rate, a dependent-edge extension, or a result for growing tagged sets.
title: The Poisson paintbox of sparse random hypergraph degree spectra
